name: OMG Group
summary: Established in 2010, OMG Group Limited is a Sydney, Australia-based enterprise specializing in health and wellness-focused food and milk beverages. Its products are distributed internationally under the Blue Dinosaur brand, reaching consumers in Australia, New Zealand, the United States, the Middle East, and Europe. The company serves a broad spectrum of the food and beverage industry, including retail, food service, food manufacturing, snacking, and quick-service establishments. Its offerings are available for purchase via e-commerce platforms, various retailers, and traditional brick-and-mortar stores. Notably, the company officially changed its name from Forbidden Foods Limited to OMG Group Limited in May 2025.
